fields.owner: Resolver constructs the command-specific object from validated components
fields.presence: Required; only the fields below enter the job

fields.owner: Command `job_schema_version`
fields.presence: Required; prep 1.5.0, chunks 1.2.0, DOCX 1.0.0

fields.owner: Command fixed pipeline; prep indexes `pipeline_by_encoding` with edition encoding
fields.presence: Required; APS selects legacy-docx-to-unicode, Unicode selects unicode-docx-ingest

fields.owner: Resolver constructs the selected store's applicable location shape using S3 roles
fields.presence: Required; local and R2 shapes use only their applicable fields

fields.owner: Selected environment store `backend`
fields.presence: Required; legacy prep may omit it and interpret local

fields.owner: Selected local store's named `$env` binding, resolved by #284
fields.presence: Required for local; omitted for R2; used value must be a nonempty absolute path

fields.owner: Selected R2 store `bucket`
fields.presence: Required for R2; omitted for local

fields.owner: Selected R2 store `url_base`, including explicit null
fields.presence: Required for R2; omitted for local; legacy prep may omit it

fields.owner: Edition `source_document.relative_path`
fields.presence: Required for local DOCX source; omitted for R2

fields.owner: Selected R2 source-store prefix + slash + edition source-relative path
fields.presence: Required for R2 DOCX source; omitted for local; prefix is consumed into key

fields.owner: Same-named edition `source_document` fields
fields.presence: Required for either backend; aps/unicode and docx; actual font inspection remains execution work

fields.owner: Selected R2 destination-store `prefix`
fields.presence: Required for R2; omitted for local

fields.owner: Selected R2 source-store `prefix`
fields.presence: Required for R2; omitted for local

fields.owner: Manifest `artifact_root` + slash + selected locale
fields.presence: Required; never inferred from manifest ID, directory, subject code, or slug

fields.owner: Manifest `artifact_root` + slash + selected locale
fields.presence: Required; must equal destination subject_dir

fields.owner: Resolver constructs only command `naming_fields` from identity/release/locale owners
fields.presence: Required; field order does not change filename formatting

fields.owner: Same-named manifest `identity` fields
fields.presence: Required for all canonical commands

fields.owner: Same-named selected edition `release` fields
fields.presence: Required strings retaining leading zeroes; independent per locale; absent from DOCX naming

fields.owner: Selected locale, matching the manifest edition and locale definition
fields.presence: Required; prep puts language in metadata instead

fields.owner: Selected edition `chapter_split` shape
fields.presence: Required; only active shape fields are copied

fields.owner: Edition split `enabled`
fields.presence: Required boolean; false produces only this field

fields.owner: Same-named edition split fields
fields.presence: Required when enabled; omitted when disabled

fields.owner: Edition regex split's explicit flags array and each declared flag
fields.presence: Required for regex, including empty array; omitted for literal/disabled; legacy regex jobs may omit flags

fields.owner: Resolver constructs declared locale metadata plus selected language
fields.presence: Required; no arbitrary metadata extension in composition

fields.owner: Selected locale, matching edition and locale definition
fields.presence: Required; hi-IN or mr-IN; no independent language override

fields.owner: Same-named locale metadata fields
fields.presence: Required explicit Devanagari and UTF-8 declarations

fields.owner: Locale metadata marker array and each declared string
fields.presence: Required array, including empty; legacy complete jobs may omit the array

fields.owner: Complete selected proofreading profile's settings object
fields.presence: Required; profile identity/envelope does not enter job JSON

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected proofreading profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required; no defaults or scalar merge

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected proofreading profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required; no defaults or scalar merge

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected proofreading profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required; no defaults or scalar merge

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected proofreading profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required; component semantics additionally require progress interval not above timeout

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected proofreading profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required, including explicit false; no defaults or scalar merge

fields.owner: Complete selected chunking profile's settings object
fields.presence: Required; profile identity/envelope does not enter job JSON

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected chunking profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required; preserve maintained BGE-M3 model and pinned revision

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected chunking profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required; preserve maintained values 78, 550, 3, and 16

fields.owner: Same-named settings in selected chunking profile (S1)
fields.presence: Every field required, including nullable device and booleans; maintained true, null, true, semantic-window-v1

fields.owner: Explicit invocation chapter list and its entries
fields.presence: Optional; absent means unspecified, not an injected list; supplied list is nonempty/unique with exactly three ASCII digits per string
